To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a two-phase process of deconstruction and skin-building can transform any website so that it is accessible to people with low vision.
the process described in this paper can transform a site that conforms to standards to a site that accommodates partially sighted users.

1) the process of deconstruction and building new skins for websites is effective in improving the usability of websites for individuals with visual impairments, 2) the process is effective even on websites with marginal accessibility, and 3) it works best on websites that conform to web standards and that are designed with the accessibility guidelines in mind.

the design and development of accessible websites for people with low vision.
the design and implementation of a system for the automatic conversion of existing websites to accommodate partially sighted users by using cascading style sheets (CSS).
the use of cascading style sheets as a means to improve accessibility for partially sighted individuals.
